question: Which of the following was the 14th Census of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2001**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **India Census 2001**

 
 
• The **2001 Census of India** was the **14th **in a series of censuses held in India every decade since 1871.
 
• The population of India was counted as **1,028,737,436** consisting of **532,223,090 **males and 496,514,346 females.
 
• The total population increased by **182,310,397**, **21.5% **more than the **846,427,039 **people counted during the 1991 census.
 
 
 
• In 2001 the density of the Population (per sq. km.) was **324**.
 
• The sex Ratio (females per 1,000 males) was **933**.
